item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00090","case1_error":"Omits Bexley’s nine added fish from the total, then arbitrarily rounds half of the resulting incorrect total.","case2_error":"Treats one student’s 105 pens as the entire three-student pool, omitting multiplication by three.","reason":"Case 1 fails to update inventory after additions; case 2 confuses an individual allocation with the pooled total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00091","case1_error":"Multiplies area by coverage, then divides by coverage, incorrectly leaving the numerical area as gallons.","case2_error":"Omits the first hose’s continued contribution during the final two hours.","reason":"Case 1 uses an incorrect rate-conversion relation; case 2 leaves out an ongoing source’s contribution.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00092","case1_error":"The leading answer marker says 48, but the derivation correctly concludes Antonio eats four meatballs.","case2_error":"Divides by servings per batch twice, mislabeling 15 batches as servings and reducing the required batch count again.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00093","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as the total ear-cleaning time, omitting the second ear.","case2_error":"Treats the sister’s 24 watched shows as her chosen shows, instead of dividing shared viewing in a 3:1 ratio.","reason":"Case 1 fails to multiply a per-item duration by item count; case 2 confuses the shared total with one chooser’s portion.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00094","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 48 − 17 − 10 as 11 instead of 21.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written seven-day sum as 107 instead of 97.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate a correctly written expression; the differing arithmetic operators do not change the mechanism.","judgment":"same"}]}
